peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 12.8% above its local comparables; 92 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bedok Reservoir MRT about 260 m, Tampines West MRT about 1,260 m; closer than 82 of 116 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Yu Neng Primary School about 400 m; more than 75 of 116 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 450 m), more than 106 of 116 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Kaki Bukit 511 Market And Food Centre about 440 m; nearest park Bedok Town Park about 60 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kaki Bukit 511 Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,200 m; Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,960 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 28 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,111 new sales and 439 resales (1,550 purchases); new sales were 71.7% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 439 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 60 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 439 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 543 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.2%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
